svg.title: The double iframe, and the postMessage channel through it
svg.desc: Three nested regions on the left. The outermost is the host page. Nested inside it, on a deliberately different origin, is the sandbox proxy iframe carrying allow-scripts and allow-same-origin. Nested inside that is the view iframe holding the server's HTML under a Content Security Policy built from the resource metadata. On the right, a numbered sequence shows the startup order: the sandbox announces itself with sandbox-proxy-ready, the host answers with sandbox-resource-ready carrying the HTML, the view sends ui/initialize and receives the host's capabilities and context, the view sends initialized, and only then may the host push tool-input and tool-result. A footer lists what the sandbox denies: the parent document object model, host cookies and storage, parent navigation, and script execution in the parent context.
svg.text: Two frames, because one would not be a sandbox.
Host page
origin A. Owns the model, the conversation, and the consent decision.
Sandbox proxy iframe
origin B, which MUST differ from the host's
sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin"
Forwards every message that is not a reserved
ui/notifications/sandbox- message, both ways.
View iframe
the server's HTML, from the ui:// resource
Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none';
script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; ...
Built from _meta.ui.csp. Omitted means the host
applies its own deny-by-default policy instead.
_meta.ui.permissions becomes the allow attribute.
Startup order, and it is strict
ui/notifications/sandbox-proxy-ready
sandbox to host, once the frame is live
ui/notifications/sandbox-resource-ready
host to sandbox, carrying the raw HTML
ui/initialize
view to host: appCapabilities, clientInfo
host replies with hostCapabilities, hostContext,
and its own protocolVersion, "2026-01-26"
ui/notifications/initialized
view to host. Until this arrives the host MUST
NOT send the view any request or notification.
ui/notifications/tool-input, then tool-result
and later, from the view, an ordinary tools/call
that the host proxies, blocks, or asks about
What the nesting denies the view: the parent document tree, the host's cookies and storage, navigation of the parent, and any script in the parent context.
ui/initialize is not MCP's initialize. That one was removed in 2026-07-28. This one lives on the postMessage channel and is unaffected by it.
